Input image 1: EDIT TARGET and identity/environment reference, the existing lone trader at her closed notebook.
Input image 2: CONTINUITY REFERENCE ONLY, the unchanged supportive frame. Do not copy the support worker into the new image and do not generate a pair.
Primary request: Replace the passive worried-person tableau with a specific, non-graphic depiction of control over earnings. The source case says a market trader's partner takes all earnings and refuses money for food. Show withholding of earnings, not poverty, not mutually agreed budgeting, and not a reassuring support conversation.
Scene: The SAME quiet back room beside the SAME produce stall. Preserve the muted-blue blouse, deep-purple skirt, brown flats, silver studs, Black African woman's age around 38, face and high braided bun from the references. Preserve the closed purple earnings notebook, oak table, teal chairs, lavender wall, mint shutter, tomato crate, simple shelf and yellow curtain, with consistent physical relationships. No decorative plant.
Action and composition: Redraw from a noticeably elevated oblique viewpoint, a closer three-quarter view across the diagonal table rather than the existing straight-on full-room view. The woman remains seated at the notebook on the left, upright and attentive, NOT resting her chin on her hand. One hand remains on her closed earnings notebook. Her other hand is open and relaxed toward the table center, indicating a request for access, never begging or grabbing. The relevant action occupies the center: her adult male partner, standing at the far right end of the table at normal human scale, is withdrawing a small visible bundle of the earnings toward his own body, away from her open hand. All visible earnings are in his possession. His body turns slightly away and his grip keeps the money with him; do not make the gesture look like handing money to her. A small money pouch near his side reinforces possession. This is NOT a customer buying tomatoes: there are no goods between them and no transaction. He is a fully clothed Black adult about 40, short hair, plain desaturated teal shirt and navy trousers. No threatening fists, towering posture, weapons, touching, shouting or physical struggle. Concern and constrained choice are conveyed by the woman's steady expression and the distance between her hand and the earnings, not tears or panic. His expression is closed and unresponsive, not monstrous. Keep both faces and all hands clearly visible within the frame, with clean anatomy.
Style: Match the references' mature polished 2D flat editorial style, clean shapes, natural adult proportions, restrained shading. Deep purple, lavender, golden yellow curtain, teal, mint and soft blue. Contemporary Rwanda-relevant everyday setting without stereotypes. Less scenic decoration and stronger focal action, breathing room around the hands and notebook. No generic smiles, celebration or resolved ending.
Format: Landscape 4:3, preferably 1440x1080. Compose for a displayed width of 290px on mobile: the money-withholding action must remain legible. All text remains outside the image. Generic stylized paper banknotes with simple color shapes, no readable denominations or realistic currency reproduction.
Avoid: Any writing, letters, numbers, captions, symbols floating above characters, arrows, split panels, infographic overlays, watermarks, logos, graphic harm or sexual imagery. Generate ONE illustration only.
